{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|arg= local

|descr= Returns vehicle sensors' threats.

|gr1= Sensors

|s1= [[getSensorThreats]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - the sensors-equipped vehicle

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s - format [<nowiki/>[object, type, sensor], ...]:
* object: [[Object]]
* type: [[String]] - can be one of:
** "missile"
** "marked"
** "locked"
* sensors: [[Array]] of [[String]]s - values can be:
** "ir"
** "laser"
** "missile"
** "radar" ('''not''' "activeradar"/"passiveradar")
** "visual"

|x1= <sqf>
private _dangers = getSensorThreats vehicle player;
/*
	returns e.g
	[
		[164230: titan_missile_atl_fly.p3d, "missile", ["visual"]],
		[164233: titan_missile_atl_fly.p3d, "threatmissile", ["radar"]]
	]
*/
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getSensorTargets]] [[listVehicleSensors]] [[listRemoteTargets]]
}}
